raw_text: Something is off about the viral farmer protest photos. I zoomed in and several people in the crowd have six fingers, the shadows point in different directions within the same frame, and there are faces that repeat in different parts of the image. These look AI-generated to me. The actual protests are real and significant but these specific images appear fabricated to exaggerate crowd sizes.
clean_text: Viral farmer protest photos show AI generation artifacts: six-fingered people, inconsistent shadows, repeated faces. Actual protests are real but these images fabricated to exaggerate crowd size.
